fusions.name: Sown in the Wound
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Rot Takes the Laggard
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 18 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Marked Territory
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to mark a patch of ground beside you for 20 seconds. Spores rise from it onto an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Carcass Bloom
fusions.desc: Every kill you make builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 20 seconds.
